caption: The drawing features a single, sculpted object positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The object resembles a wooden ladle or scoop with a handle shaped like the head and neck of a bird, perhaps a swan or goose. The main body of the ladle is broad and curves gently to form a concave scoop for holding materials. The handle extends smoothly upward in an S-curve, ending in a stylized bird’s head with a defined beak and slight indentation to suggest eyes. The color of the object consists mainly of varying shades of brown and yellow, with darker brown lines and patches indicating wood grain and shadows, giving it a realistic, three-dimensional appearance. The rest of the image is devoid of detail, text, or additional objects, aside from a small handwritten signature near the bottom right.
title: Butter Worker
